segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSE study guide
segments.zh: 朋友们好，欢迎来到你们的频道 HSE Study Guide

segments.text: Electricity is used daily
segments.zh: 电每天都在使用，

segments.text: But if we do not follow proper safety then it can be very dangerous
segments.zh: 但如果我们不遵守正确的安全措施，它就会非常危险。

segments.text: So we get shock, burns, fires from electrical accidents to even photo accidents
segments.zh: 电气事故会让我们遭受电击、烧伤、火灾，甚至致命事故。

segments.text: So in today's video we will talk about 10 important electrical safety rules that every worker should know
segments.zh: 所以在今天的视频中，我们将讨论每个工人都应该知道的 10 条重要电气安全规则。

segments.text: So let's start the video
segments.zh: 那我们开始视频吧

segments.text: Rule number one is always de-energize equipment before working
segments.zh: 第一条规则是：工作前务必给设备断电。

segments.text: Means any electrical inspection, repair or maintenance work before starting
segments.zh: 意思是在开始任何电气检查、维修或保养工作之前，

segments.text: The power supply of equipment is completely closed and it is very important to isolate
segments.zh: 设备的电源要完全关闭，而且隔离非常重要，

segments.text: And always follow proper lockout tagout i.e. lot of procedures
segments.zh: 并且始终遵守正确的上锁挂牌，也就是 LOTO 程序。

segments.text: This reduces the risk of accidental power on when a worker is working
segments.zh: 这样可以降低工人作业时设备意外通电的风险。

segments.text: Remember it is very dangerous to work on live equipment
segments.zh: 记住，在带电设备上作业是非常危险的。

segments.text: Rule number two is to use proper PPE
segments.zh: 第二条规则是使用合适的个人防护装备。

segments.text: It is very important to wear proper PPE during electrical work
segments.zh: 在电气作业中穿戴合适的个人防护装备非常重要，

segments.text: Like insulated gloves, safety shoes, arc flash clothing, helmet and eye protections
segments.zh: 比如绝缘手套、安全鞋、防电弧服、安全帽和护目用品。

segments.text: PPE protects you from serious injuries
segments.zh: 个人防护装备能保护你免受严重伤害，

segments.text: So never ignore PPE
segments.zh: 所以千万不要忽视个人防护装备。

segments.text: Rule number three is never touch live electrical parts
segments.zh: 第三条规则是：绝不触碰带电的电气部件。

segments.text: Never assume that the circuit is safe
segments.zh: 绝不要想当然地认为电路是安全的，

segments.text: Always consider the electrical circuit as live
segments.zh: 始终把电路当作带电的，

segments.text: Until it is confirmed with proper testing that it is safe
segments.zh: 直到通过正确的检测确认它是安全的为止。

segments.text: Use the approved equipment before touching any electrical part
segments.zh: 在触碰任何电气部件之前，要使用经过认可的设备。

segments.text: A small mistake can cause a big accident
segments.zh: 一个小小的失误就可能造成大事故。

segments.text: Rule number four is to inspect tools and cables before use
segments.zh: 第四条规则是：使用前检查工具和电缆。

segments.text: Before starting the work, inspect electrical tools and cables
segments.zh: 开始工作之前，要检查电动工具和电缆，

segments.text: Check if there is any insulation damage, exposed wire, loose plug or broken cable
segments.zh: 检查是否有绝缘损坏、裸露电线、插头松动或电缆破损。

segments.text: If the equipment is damaged, do not use it
segments.zh: 如果设备有损坏，就不要使用，

segments.text: Immediately report and replace it
segments.zh: 要立即报告并更换。

segments.text: Rule number five is to keep water away from electrical equipment
segments.zh: 第五条规则是：让水远离电气设备。

segments.text: The combination of water and electricity is very dangerous
segments.zh: 水和电的组合是非常危险的。

segments.text: Weight hands or weight surface increases the risk of electric shock
segments.zh: 湿手或潮湿的表面会增加触电的风险，

segments.text: So always operate the switches or machinery with dry hands
segments.zh: 所以始终要用干燥的手操作开关或机器，

segments.text: And avoid using electrical tools in the weight area
segments.zh: 并避免在潮湿区域使用电动工具。

segments.text: Rule number six is to use correct rated equipment and fuses
segments.zh: 第六条规则是：使用额定值正确的设备和保险丝。

segments.text: Never overload circuits or extension boards
segments.zh: 绝不要让电路或插线板过载。

segments.text: Always use correct voltage and current rating devices
segments.zh: 始终使用电压和电流额定值正确的设备、

segments.text: Fuses or breakers
segments.zh: 保险丝或断路器。

segments.text: Wrong rating can cause overheating and electrical fire
segments.zh: 额定值不对会导致过热和电气火灾。

segments.text: Rule number seven is to maintain safe distance from high voltage areas
segments.zh: 第七条规则是：与高压区域保持安全距离。

segments.text: It is very important to maintain safe distance from high voltage areas
segments.zh: 与高压区域保持安全距离非常重要，

segments.text: Transformers, substations, overhead power lines and high voltage panels
segments.zh: 变压器、变电站、架空电力线和高压配电盘，

segments.text: Do not go without authorization
segments.zh: 未经授权不要进入。

segments.text: Always follow warning signs and barricades
segments.zh: 始终遵守警示标志和隔离围栏。

segments.text: Rule number eight is to ensure proper grounding and earthing
segments.zh: 第八条规则是：确保正确接地。

segments.text: Proper grounding or earthing or electrical fault provides protection
segments.zh: 正确的接地能在发生电气故障时提供保护。

segments.text: If the grounding is not proper, then the electric current can pass through the body
segments.zh: 如果接地不良，电流就可能流经人体，

segments.text: So it is very important to inspect the grounding system regularly
segments.zh: 所以定期检查接地系统非常重要。

segments.text: Rule number nine is only trained persons should perform electrical work
segments.zh: 第九条规则是：只有经过培训的人员才能进行电气作业。

segments.text: Electrical work should only be done by trained and authorized persons
segments.zh: 电气作业只能由经过培训并获得授权的人员来做，

segments.text: And trained workers should never attend electrical repairs or panel openings
segments.zh: 未经培训的工人绝不应该参与电气维修或打开配电盘。

segments.text: It can be very dangerous to joke with electricity
segments.zh: 拿电开玩笑可能非常危险。

segments.text: Rule number ten is to report electrical hazards immediately
segments.zh: 第十条规则是：立即报告电气危害。

segments.text: If you see spark, burning spales, exposed wires, overheating equipment or frequently tripping breakers
segments.zh: 如果你看到火花、焦糊味、裸露电线、过热的设备或频繁跳闸的断路器，

segments.text: Then report immediately
segments.zh: 那就要立即报告。

segments.text: Ignoring electrical hazards can be a major accident in the future
segments.zh: 忽视电气危害，将来可能酿成重大事故。

segments.text: So friends, these were the 10 essential electrical safety rules
segments.zh: 朋友们，以上就是 10 条必不可少的电气安全规则，

segments.text: It is very important to follow in every workplace
segments.zh: 在每个工作场所遵守它们都非常重要。

segments.text: Safety is not only a person's responsibility, but it is a responsibility of all of us
segments.zh: 安全不只是某一个人的责任，而是我们所有人的责任。

segments.text: If you found this video helpful, then like and share the video
segments.zh: 如果你觉得这个视频有帮助，请点赞并分享视频，

segments.text: And don't forget to subscribe EHS's study guide channel
segments.zh: 别忘了订阅 HSE Study Guide 频道。

segments.text: That's all for today, see you in the next video with a new topic
segments.zh: 今天就到这里，我们下期视频带着新话题再见。

segments.text: Till then take care, bye-bye
segments.zh: 在那之前请多保重，拜拜
